title: Urgent Tests in "SchoolWorld"
content: Anyone else had dreams lately about having all sorts of school tests? Like it looks like a relatively benign dream about school and such, but the "chapter tests" and such feel different, almost like the fate of the universe is at stake or something. Whatever the case, I had an rather vivid dream that was essentially a mix of my old high school and middle school classrooms. But what was strange is, instead of it being a classic stress dream about finals, in the dream I actually got good scores. I actually remember the numbers: an 85/100 and a 95/100. Like I was expecting a junky teacher to jump out of the whiteboard or something lol.
